introduction: Families First is Tennessee TANF. Apply through One DHS and discuss the Personal Responsibility Plan as part of the eligibility review.
description: Families First is Tennessee TANF. Apply through One DHS and discuss the Personal Responsibility Plan as part of the eligibility review.

sections.who: TDHS reviews income, resources, status and a qualifying child living with a parent or eligible relative. Child-only cases receive different adult treatment.
sections.get: Approved support includes temporary cash and potentially transportation, childcare, education or employment services.
sections.docs:
• Child age and relationship records.
  • Household income and resources.
  • Identity and requested status evidence.
sections.apply:
1. Apply through One DHS

    Use the Families First application link.

  2. Complete the eligibility review

    Answer document and interview requests.

  3. Discuss your plan

    Ask about work or training duties, exemptions and support needed to participate.
sections.after: Keep plan records and report changes. Ask the worker about a safety concern or other good-cause barrier before missing an assigned action.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Families First services and portal, Child categories and responsibility plan. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can a relative request a child-only case?
The state describes a route where a nonparent relative chooses to be excluded from the adult benefit group.
Is Families First only a cash payment?
It also describes employment and related support services.
Do all adults have the same work duty?
The state provides participation rules and exemptions assessed for the case.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
